title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne shitje ne Bllok prane Librit Universitar ne Tirane (ID 4111840)
description_sq:
Ne Bllok, prane Librit Universitar, ne nje nder Pallatet me Prestigjoze ne Tirane, shitet Apartament 1+1, siperfaqe 75,5 m² (66,5 m2) me dokumenta te rregullta nga firma, kati 6 me ashensor (jo i fundit), garderobe, tualete, ballkon, orientimi me diell.
Pallati i projektuar nga studio arkitekturore dhe inxhinjerike te huaja eshte ne katin e 4-te ndertim, perfundon deri ne fund te vitit
Shitet 4300 euro/m2
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in the Block near the University Library in Tirana (ID 4111840)
description_en: In the Block, near the University Library, in one of the most prestigious buildings in Tirana, 1+1 Apartment for sale, surface area 75.5 m² (66.5 m2) with regular documents from the company, 6th floor with elevator (not the last), wardrobe, toilets, balcony, sunny orientation. The building, designed by a foreign architectural and engineering studio, is on the 4th floor of the building, will be completed by the end of the year. For sale: 4300 euros/m2
